how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Supreme Court of India at www.sci.gov.in to access the online application link.
Complete the online registration form by entering required personal and educational details.
Upload scanned copies of recent photograph, signature, and requisite documents (Class Xth, XIIth Standard/10+2 certificate, caste/community certificate, and disability certificate if applicable).
Make the payment of the application fee online through the payment gateway provided by UCO Bank.
Preview the filled-up application form carefully and submit it, as application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified.
Retain the application number carefully for generating the Admit Card and future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions; admission to the examination and interview is purely provisional. Candidates seeking reservation benefits must possess a valid caste/community certificate and non-creamy layer certificate issued by the competent authority. No TA/DA will be payable to candidates for appearing in the Test/Interview. Admit cards will not be sent by post; candidates must download them from the Supreme Court website. Candidates working in Central/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, Statutory bodies, or Nationalized Banks must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of document verification. Submitting more than one application form will result in only the lastly submitted application being considered by the Registry.

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Supreme Court of India has advertised a total of 130 tentative vacancies for the post of Junior Court Attendant (Group 'C' Non-Clerical post). The number of posts may be subject to change due to administrative exigencies and/or requirements of the Registry.

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualification and eligibility conditions as on 1st October, 2026.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum X Standard examination conducted by any Board/Institute recognized by the Government, and maximum XII Standard/10+2 examination conducted by any Board/Institute recognized by the Government.

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should not be below 18 years of age and the upper age limit is 27 years as on 1st October, 2026. Supreme Court of India has specified that no relaxation in age will be allowed to candidates working in other Government Departments/Public Sector Undertakings/Statutory bodies/Nationalized Banks, etc.

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: The Junior Court Attendant, apart from other duties, will be required to perform the following tasks: Carry files, paper books, books, and records. Dusting of tables, chairs, almirahs, windows, book-shelves, and other furniture. Serve tea, coffee, snacks, water, and other forms of refreshment to officers/officials of the Registry.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of the Supreme Court of India at www.sci.gov.in to access the online application link. Complete the online registration form by entering required personal and educational details. Upload scanned copies of recent photograph, signature, and requisite documents (Class Xth, XIIth Standard/10+2 certificate, caste/community certificate, and disability certificate if applicable). Make the payment of the application fee online through the payment gateway provided by UCO Bank. Preview the filled-up application form carefully and submit it, as application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified. Retain the application number carefully for generating the Admit Card and future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Supreme Court of India Junior Court Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 130 tentative vacancies have been announced for the Junior Court Attendant post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 25th November, 2026 at 11.55 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Court Attendant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a minimum X Standard examination and maximum XII Standard/10+2 examination conducted by any Board/Institute recognized by the Government.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit and cut-off date?
faq.answer: Candidates should not be below 18 years of age and the upper age limit is 27 years as on 1st October, 2026, with admissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and Reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is Rs. 1,500/- for General/Unreserved candidates and Rs. 750/- for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), Ex-Servicemen, and Physically Challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of the Supreme Court of India at www.sci.gov.in between 4th November, 2026 and 25th November, 2026.

faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Objective Type Test (100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks with 0.25 negative marking) and an Interview carrying 25 marks.

faq.answer: Selected candidates are placed in Level 3 of the Pay Matrix with an initial Basic Pay of Rs. 21,700-69,100/- plus allowances.
